T2 initial implementation: ground plane (y=0) unioned into the raymarch SDF, snapToGround op, crude strain approximation (physics.ts — overlap graph + Dijkstra shortest-path-to-ground tree + subtree volume / neck area), blue->red strain color replacing S1's flat base color, permanent approximation banner, unreachable islands forced to max strain. Verified in isolated Chrome on port 5185 via DOM/eval (screenshot tool was unreliable this session, see README Observation): snap-to-ground shifts all balls by the correct delta, moderate radius-thinning of a supported ball reddens it (0.396->0.630), island balls report island:true/normalized:1, export->import round-trip is byte-identical. Found and recorded a real limitation: thinning a ball enough to fully detach its dependents can non-monotonically lower its own strain as load reroutes — documented in README Hypothesis, not fixed yet.
